import cv2
import numpy as np
import json
import math

with open('/work/poses.json') as f:
    poses = json.load(f)

def ground_point(f_id, u, v):
    # camera at height 1.55 m, floor at y_cam = 1.55 m
    # fx = fy = 256.0, cx = cy = 255.5
    z_cam = 256.0 * 1.55 / (v - 255.5)
    x_cam = (u - 255.5) / 256.0 * z_cam
    pose = poses[str(f_id)]
    h_rad = math.radians(pose['h'])
    # heading vector: [sin(h), cos(h)], right vector: [cos(h), -sin(h)]
    xw = pose['x'] + x_cam * math.cos(h_rad) + z_cam * math.sin(h_rad)
    yw = pose['y'] - x_cam * math.sin(h_rad) + z_cam * math.cos(h_rad)
    return xw, yw

# Frame 24: Chair 1 right in front!
# Leg bottoms on the floor:
img24 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0024.png')
# Chair 1 legs in 24:
# Pose 24: (-1.366, 3.866, h=330)
# Find lowest brown pixels of chair 1:
mask24 = (img24[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img24[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
         (img24[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img24[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
         (img24[:, :, 0] < 60)
ys, xs = np.where(mask24)
print(f"Chair 1 in 24: bottom v={ys.max()}, u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Chair 1 pos from 24 ground contact:", ground_point(24, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# Frame 37: Chair 2 right in front!
# Pose 37: (1.354, 4.720, h=120)
img37 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0037.png')
mask37 = (img37[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img37[:, :, 2] < 170) & \
         (img37[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img37[:, :, 1] < 100) & \
         (img37[:, :, 0] < 60)
mask37[:, 400:] = 0
ys, xs = np.where(mask37)
print(f"Chair 2 in 37: bottom v={ys.max()}, u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Chair 2 pos from 37 ground contact:", ground_point(37, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# Frame 38: Floor lamp right in front!
# Pose 38: (1.354, 4.220, h=180)
# Base disc bottom:
img38 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0038.png')
# base disc is dark grey around x=140..170, y=410..430
dark38 = (img38[:, :, 0] > 40) & (img38[:, :, 0] < 80) & \
         (img38[:, :, 1] > 40) & (img38[:, :, 1] < 80) & \
         (img38[:, :, 2] > 40) & (img38[:, :, 2] < 80)
dark38[:, 250:] = 0
ys, xs = np.where(dark38)
print(f"Lamp base in 38: bottom v={ys.max()}, u={np.mean(xs):.1f}")
print("Lamp pos from 38 ground contact:", ground_point(38, np.mean(xs), ys.max()))

# Frame 38: Sideboard counter in 38:
# Pose 38: (1.354, 4.220, h=180)
# Sideboard is at foreground right
